name: koala
description: A koala head with rounded side ears and a tall nose.
useCase: Choose a koala in an animal selector or nature guide.
misuse: Pair the stylized head with its name when identifying an animal.

16.reason: Rounded side ears and a tall nose distinguish the head; a small upward hint balances its lower cheeks.

24.reason: The independently drawn round ears, complete eyes and prominent nose retain clear space at interface size.
